business_problem: Mandaya Royal Hospital Puri needed a generative AI clinical decision support approach that clinicians could trust, after staff were already using unapproved public GenAI tools such as Gemini and ChatGPT that posed hallucination, bias, and governance risks in patient care.
solution_summary: Mandaya Royal Hospital Puri implemented UpToDate clinical decision support with UpToDate Expert AI as part of its digitalization strategy for clinician decision-making. In the hospital workflow, clinicians enter natural-language questions at the point of care, and UpToDate Expert AI acts as a generative AI conversational layer over UpToDate’s rigorously reviewed clinical interpretations and evidence-based clinical database. The hospital did not deploy the tool blindly: it appointed clinicians to test the system with patient cases and assess whether responses appropriately summarized medical background, flagged issues to watch, proposed care plans, suggested follow-up questions, and presented answers in a structured, concise format. Transparency was also a gating requirement, so clinicians could inspect the supporting evidence behind recommendations before using them. The resulting deployment is designed to strengthen, not replace, physician judgment while reducing reliance on shadow AI.

solution_components.name: UpToDate clinical decision support
solution_components.role: Provides the expert-vetted clinical interpretations and evidence base that clinicians consult for care decisions.

solution_components.name: UpToDate Expert AI
solution_components.role: Adds a generative AI conversational interface so clinicians can ask natural-language questions and receive context-rich, evidence-grounded answers at the point of care.

data_flow: Clinicians submit natural-language clinical questions into UpToDate Expert AI at the point of care. The AI layer draws on UpToDate’s rigorously reviewed clinical database and interpretations to synthesize structured responses, which clinicians then review alongside supporting evidence before applying the information to diagnosis, treatment, and care planning.
business_outcome: The hospital strengthened clinician decision support with faster access to trusted evidence, reduced dependence on unapproved public GenAI tools, and aimed to improve care quality and patient outcomes while keeping final clinical decisions with physicians.
